JournalText: A surface-built descent platform forced into basalt that looks recently fractured, as if the cavern opened around it rather than being drilled.
Translucent fungal caps that gather condensation and glow from the underside, turning the marsh into a field of dim lanterns.
Fine mineral sediment that settles beneath shallow water and creates unusually clean reflections in near darkness.
Milky crystal veins that brighten in slow waves when exposed to scanner energy.
A mineral seam that answers scanner pulses with a delayed harmonic vibration, suggesting a connected structure deeper in the cavern.
A geothermal vent whose orange mineral crust radiates heat through wet black stone.
Threadlike organisms that grow only near vent exhaust, glowing briefly when heat pressure rises.
A distant chamber so large its ceiling reads like a second horizon, with suspended stone shelves fading into luminous fog.
